thread:
marta: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — consolidated remediation list and owners below. I pinned the doc to the channel.

marta: TL;DR: recurring eviction pattern traced to cold cache storms + autoscaler mis-config. Actions: owner, ETA, and PR/issue link.

devin: thanks — can you drop the owners so I can add to sprint board? :+1:

marta: 1) Autoscaler policy tweak (min replicas, scale window) -> owner: li-wang -> ETA: 2026-04-06 -> issue: github.com/rw/infra/issues/482
2) Prefix/KV cache warmup task for high-qps routes -> owner: algina -> ETA: 2026-04-10 -> PR: pending
3) Runbook step: explicit cache-check and forced pre-warm for canaries -> owner: devin -> ETA: 2026-04-03 -> PR: infra/runbooks#71
4) Post-deploy regression test for eviction patterns -> owner: samir -> ETA: 2026-04-09 -> ticket: QA-627

li-wang: taking autoscaler policy tweak. I'll add exact flags and a test plan.

algina: taking warmup task. Plan is to add a short lived job that touches top-100 prefixes on deploy and on scale-up. Will prototype tomorrow. :rocket:

devin: I'll update the triage playbook with a one-line checklist and the commands we used in the PM.

samir: assigned the regression test — will pair with QA to add nightly smoke for eviction rate.

oncall-bot: Reminder: Automatic follow-up check-in scheduled in 7 days (2026-04-02) — add comment to issue to mark progress.

marta: Updated triage guidance (excerpt):
- Step 1: Confirm symptom: "inference router OOMs / eviction spike"
- Step 2: Run these quick checks:
```
# recent evictions and OOM events
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=router -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=router --since=30m | grep -i "Evicted\|OOM"
# check autoscaler status and recent decisions
redwood infra autoscaler describe --pool router --window 30m
```
- Step 3: If evictions > 5 in 30m -> escalate to infra-oncall and post summary in #incidents (include the autoscaler.describe output).
- Step 4: If no ack within 15m -> page eng-pager and mark incident.severity=high.

devin: adding explicit command for cache warmup and where to run it:
```
# run on a maintenance node or deploy job
redwood cache prewarm --model router --prefixes-file s3://rw-deploy/prefixes/top100.txt --concurrency 8
```

algina: Also adding a note to the playbook: if prewarm fails repeatedly, fallback to pinned smaller model variant and notify product.

samir: For ownership tracking — propose this pattern: create a short lived project board card per action with owner + weekly check-ins until closed. Works for me.

marta: Agreed. I've created the board cards and linked them to the PM. Will run weekly sweep and post updates in this thread.

devin: small UX suggestion for runbook: add a copy-paste escalation message template so oncall can quickly paste to paging: "<summary> - seen evictions X in 30m on router pool, autoscaler decisions attached: <link>"

li-wang: added the autoscaler flag values we're proposing to the issue. Will open the rollout PR after we validate in staging.

algina: ETA note: prototype for prewarm job by 2026-03-27 EOD. Will request a short canary deploy.

marta: OK — next check-in in 7 days per oncall-bot. If anyone finishes earlier post updates here. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

devin: noted. I'll push runbook edits today and link PR.

samir: I'll add nightly smoke and tag the ticket when complete.

oncall-bot: Follow-up: next scheduled reminder 2026-04-02 17:00 UTC.

marta: closing loop — this thread will be the single source of truth for progress until all action items are closed.

algina: quick question — should we also add a step to verify KV-cache TTL settings? I saw one service with very low TTL causing chattiness.

marta: yes, add TTL verification as part of cache warmup task. Good catch.

li-wang: will validate minReplica changes do not impact cold-start latency in staging. If we see regression, we fallback to prewarm + smaller batch size.

devin: thanks — will add fallback decision tree to playbook.

marta: thanks everyone. I'll post the final playbook diff when merged.
